name: AbyssCN-oh-my-dag
description: oh-my-dag — the full harness around the model, on the pi coding-agent runtime. DAG execution engine (typed nodes, concurrent fan-out, cross-model verify, escalate on failure), pathfinder planning, agent-template registry, self-consolidating memory, code-enforced gates, MCP router, 22 skills. omd is the bundled terminal agent.
